page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Marginal notes in the right margin, beside the lower paragraph. Running head top centre-left with page number top right. Gathering signature and catchword at the foot.

main_text.p: tionis,& generationis stabilient.vocabun-turq; scpientes[?] ruptura[m],reductores semitarum ad habitandū. Spiritus Domini illud operabitur;& verbum ejus quo militabunt, in infirmitate illorum fortitudini hostium dominabitur: non enim illi erunt qui loquentur aut operabuntur, sed Spiritus Dei qui in illis habirabit. Idcirco ne desperes si labijs es inquinatis, sacro igne purgabunt labia tua Seraphim,&c anferent iniquitatem atq; transgressionem tuam;gloriam Domini conspicies, & vocanti respondebis, quia ipse coroborabit te: quærenti quem mittat dices,Ecce me Domine, mittas servū tuum in vineam tuam:sic prosperabitur opus Domini sub manibus tuis, quia ipse brachium tuum confirmabit, qui Spiritu suo vivificat mortuos,& debiles accingit robore.

Graviora alioquin hæc sunt, magisque Spiritus Sancti robore opusardua, quam vt quis humana constantia di[?] robore opus est ei qui innixus, animo læto & præsenti rerum conditione contento, in ijs diu versari possit. hoc opere feliciter versabitur.Quem namque sola hujus seculi bona respicientem, non discruciet, ita inter barbaros extorrem,afflictum, rebus omnibus destitutum, morti indies destinatum degere, ut an ad extremum usque vitæ diem inter eos hæsurus sit ignoret; quum domi inter amicos, beatus,summa in copia

page.notes: The right-margin notes are in small italic type. The first note reads "Spiritus Sancti robore opus est ei qui in hoc opere feliciter versabitur." It is split across lines with hyphens: "Spiritus San-", "di[?] robore opus", "est ei qui in", "hoc opere feli-", "citer versabi-", "tur." The first word of the second line, "di[?]", is uncertain. The word "scpientes[?]" in the first line is doubtful. The printed text has "fcpientes" with a long s, rendered here as "scpientes[?]". The word "anferent" is printed as is, and "vocabunturq;" is printed as "vocabunturq;" with a semicolon in place of the -que abbreviation, which is kept as printed. The line "&c. [continues on next page]" in type="foot" is an editorial note and is not printed text, so it should be removed. The catchword "&c fe-" is printed at the bottom right.
